Meeting Date:                  5/24/2023
Sponsor(s):                    Quinn (13)
Type:                         Ordinance
Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 16-N at 6700 block of W.
                              65th St.              ,                      .
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                   ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION I.The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing ali of the
RT4, Residential, Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District symbols and
indications as shown on Map No. 16-N in the area bound by:

      a line 135 feet north of and parallel to West 65'^ Street; South Normandy Avenue;
      West 65'^ Street; a line 136 feet east of and parallel to South Oak Park Avenue: a
      line 50 feet north of and parallel to West     Street; a line 128 feet east of and
      parallel to South Oak Park Avenue; a line 125 feet north of and parallel to West
      65'^ Street; South Oak Park Avenue

to those of a RS2, Residential Single-Unit (Detached) House District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                               Marty
                                               Alderm




Common Address:
6700 block of West 65^^ Street
